entry_state: Closed basis, authorization and commit records bind one event and its evidence, with synthetic and real book modes distinct. Methods and extensions require explicit preconditions, schemas and immutable locks. The OrderedEPS report reference now specifies exact contexts, inventories, series timing, rational arithmetic, result traces and failure statuses; documentary results mutate no accounting state.
exit_state: AppendixA closes with a finite company-to-EPS bridge preserving legal books, dated journals and share histories. AppendixB preserves the historical Core0 grammar and records while directing new exchanges to portable contracts. Its typing, unknown-value, rule-selection and borrowing-request examples retain the body's meanings; the traceability table links requirements to conformance cases. The research/source appendix and bibliography remain.

The Core0 grammar is identified as historical teaching material, not the current full textual frontend. Its small code text and continuation are legible at the inspected resolution.

The typing rule defines same-currency addition with separate context compatibility; unknown guards remain formulas rather than false.
Rule precedence is defined through an acyclic override relation, with singleton, empty and conflict outcomes; the final borrowing request returns5and7 separately and supplies no unconditional mean.
